answer: A work-slot deposit burn stops a tide of fake identities by charging each slot separately. An agent posts 40 credits as a kernel deposit, and a jury checks the result; a jade receipt binds that deposit to one slot only and cannot be reused. Failed work burns the 40 credits, so the k-th fake identity needs a fresh 40 credits and a fresh fake job. Making 1,000 fake slots burns 40,000 credits, linear with no bulk discount, and slot rental fails because a rented slot loses its own deposit on rejection. An honest agent posts one deposit, passes one check, and recovers it with the task fee.
